title: Folio 5: The Secretary Who Kept the Sultan's Secrets | The Honest Historian – Stories from Beyhaqi
description:
On the day his friend was hanged, he refused to eat. On the night the empire began to crack, the sultan called him in alone. This is Bu Nasr Moshkan, master of the Ghaznavid chancery, Beyhaqi's teacher for nineteen years, and the quiet man who taught him how to survive a dangerous court and how to tell the truth about it.

0:00 Cold open
0:18 Welcome
0:58 The house of letters
2:20 Master and pupil
3:20 Like ten men
5:11 The day of the gallows
6:10 A night with the sultan
7:59 Prison would be sweeter
9:08 A cold Friday
10:35 What he left behind
11:49 How to survive
12:25 Next week

Source: Tarikh-e Beyhaqi: Bu Nasr's advice to Amir Masud (remnant of volume five); the hanging of Hasanak (volume six); Bu Nasr's counsel to the Amir, his offence at the Amir, and his death (volume nine, year 431 AH); with Encyclopaedia Iranica (Yusofi, 'Bayhaqi, Abu'l-Fazl') and standard reference works for dates (head of the chancery about 1011/12 to his death in 1039/40).
Retold in English from the Persian original by Mehdi Rahmani and narrated with an AI rendering of his own voice.
